description: Expand the error handling in app/api/riot/route.ts to cover the missing RIOT_API_KEY case. Currently, when RIOT_API_KEY is not configured, lib/riot-api.ts throws RiotApiError('RIOT_API_KEY is not configured', 500). The catch block only handles status 401 and 403 with the user-friendly 503 response. The fix must also catch the missing-key case (status 500 with 'RIOT_API_KEY' in the error message) and return the same 503 'Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later' response.
steps: Read app/api/riot/route.ts to understand the current error handling in the catch block

Modify the catch block for RiotApiError: expand the condition from `if (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403)` to also match when the error message contains 'RIOT_API_KEY' (indicating the key is missing/not configured). This way, status 500 errors about the missing key are also caught.
The expanded condition should be: `if (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403 || error.message.includes('RIOT_API_KEY'))` returning the same 503 user-friendly response.
Run 'bun run build' to confirm the build passes.
Run 'bun run lint' to confirm no lint errors.
acceptance_criteria: The catch block in app/api/riot/route.ts handles the missing-key case (RiotApiError with status 500 and message containing 'RIOT_API_KEY') by returning the 503 user-friendly response
'bun run build' succeeds with zero errors
findings: Build and lint pass cleanly. The worker_threads warnings from Bun are cosmetic and do not affect the build.
